description: Removes the mark for check-in that THIS session put on objects (handles as in tia_objects_mark, for example from tia_markings or the tia_obj_* tools); the mark of other sessions is never touched, so it is never refused because of other users. An object this session did not mark is skipped (not_marked); with nothing to apply the answer is 200 with applied:[]. Returns {action, session, applied, skipped, states}. Refusals: no_local_session, ambiguous_session, 404 not_found for an unresolvable handle. `session` is the name or the full path of an open local session (as listed by tia_local_sessions; the project path first, then the project name ignoring case) and may be left out when exactly one session is open: none open is 409 no_local_session, several open without `session` (or a selector that matches several) is 409 ambiguous_session (details.sessions lists index, name and path), an unknown one is 404 not_found. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve (toApply, skipped or the same refusal) WITHOUT unmarking. Nothing is ever checked in to the Project Server: check-in (CloseAndCommit) is not offered by any tool. Maps to POST /multiuser/localsessions/markings/unmark {session?, handles}. Class M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

handles.description: 1 to 200 object handles (positive integers) of objects of the local session

session.description: name or full path of the open local session (from tia_local_sessions); optional when exactly one session is open

name: tia_objects_unmark
title: TIA — unmark objects
